blocks.text: Mo-assar baat cheet aur kahani sunane ka fun khayalat bayan karne, doosron se jurne aur parhai, kaam aur rozmarra zindagi mein dairpa asar chhorne mein madad dete hain.

blocks.prompt: Entrepreneurs ko baat cheet ki maharat kyun chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Apna khayal gahakon, investors aur team ko itna wazeh samjhane ke liye ke un ki himayat mile.

items: Baat cheet aur kahani khayalat ko logon se jorti hai.
